sources.name: University of Sydney Vet Hospital pages
sources.note: Own pages opened (contact and emergency); Camperdown 24 h, Camden not 24 h for small animals.

sources.name: SASH location pages
sources.note: Own pages opened for North Ryde, Alexandria, Northern Beaches, Central Coast, state and call-sash pages.

sources.name: Animal Referral Hospital network pages
sources.note: Own clinic pages opened for Homebush, Gosford, Wollongong.

sources.name: Sydney Animal Hospitals emergency pages
sources.note: Group's pages opened; used for NEVS and Northern Beaches day clinics and referral list.

entries.name: University Veterinary Teaching Hospital Sydney (Camperdown)
entries.duty: Open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Emergency cases do not need an appointment.
entries.note: Contact page: 'Open 24 hours, 365 days a year'; emergency page: 'open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year'. University of Sydney.

entries.name: University Veterinary Teaching Hospital Camden
entries.duty: Monday to Friday 8am to 6pm. No 24-hour small animal emergency care; use a 24-hour hospital after hours.
entries.note: Page: small animal services no longer include 24-hour emergency care; livestock/equine on-farm emergency 24/7 (not listed as small animal).

entries.name: SASH North Ryde
entries.duty: Open 24 hours, 365 days a year. No booking needed for emergencies; cases are triaged on arrival.
entries.note: Page: 'Open 24 hours - 365 days per year'. Phone on page; sydneyanimalhospitals.com.au lists a different number (02 9199 8935) for SASH, 9889 0289 confirmed on the SASH locations page; the 9199 8935 number is from a third-party page.

entries.name: SASH Alexandria
entries.duty: Open 24 hours, 365 days a year. No booking needed for emergencies.

entries.name: SASH Northern Beaches
entries.duty: Open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, including weekends and public holidays. No appointment needed for emergencies.
entries.note: Page: open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

entries.name: SASH Central Coast
entries.duty: Open 24 hours, 365 days a year. Walk-in emergencies welcome without an appointment.

entries.name: SASH Western Sydney
entries.note: Locations page lists 'Western Sydney 24/7', 1 Rowood Road, Prospect NSW 2148, (02) 8609 9444; state/nsw page also says '24/7 emergency and specialist veterinary care'. The 'Opening November 9th' text on that page belongs to Perth, not Prospect. sydneyanimalhospitals.com.au lists a different number (02 9199 8935) for Prospect; own page number used. The page has no explicit opening date for Prospect, so confirm status.

entries.name: Animal Referral Hospital (ARH) Homebush
entries.duty: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including public holidays. Specialist consultations by referral, Mon-Fri 8am to 6pm.

entries.name: Animal Referral Hospital (ARH) Gosford
entries.address: Unit 3, 401 Manns Road, West Gosford NSW 2250
entries.duty: Open 24 hours, 7 days a week, every day of the year.
entries.note: Page: 'Open 24 hours, 7 days a week, every day of the year'.

entries.name: Animal Referral Hospital (ARH) Wollongong
entries.duty: Open 24 hours on Saturday and Sunday, and after hours Monday to Friday, including public holidays. Call ahead for weekday opening times.
entries.note: Page: 'Open 24 hours Sat-Sun, and after hours Mon-Fri'; not 24 h every day so flag false.

entries.name: Animal Referral and Emergency Centre (AREC) Newcastle
entries.duty: Open 24/7 for emergencies. Please call before bringing your pet in.
entries.note: Contact page: 'open 24/7 for emergencies'; home page: 24/7 emergency and referral care. Brunker Road Vets page gave a second Broadmeadow address (4 Lang Road); AREC pages used.

entries.name: Veterinary Specialists of Sydney (VSOS)
entries.duty: Specialist and emergency hospital in the Sutherland Shire. Call ahead to confirm opening hours.
entries.note: Downgraded by checker: the 24/7 claim rests only on a June 2020 news article (no phone, no clinic name); vsos.com.au could not be opened (provenance) and the emergency-care page gives name, address and phone but no hours. Re-verify on the clinic's own site.

entries.name: Northside Emergency Veterinary Service (NEVS)
entries.address: 335 Mona Vale Road, Terrey Hills NSW 2084
entries.duty: Open 24/7 emergency service on Sydney's northern side.
entries.note: Source is Sydney Animal Hospitals page ('NEVS ... Open 24/7'); nevs.net.au itself could not be opened (provenance). Third-party 24/7 claim, explicit on the page. Address conflict: sydneyanimalhospitals.com.au/emergency-care lists 16 Myoora Road, Terrey Hills; source page lists 335 Mona Vale Road; phone (02) 9452 2933 identical on both. Confirm address before relying on it.

entries.name: Sydney Animal Hospitals Newport
entries.duty: Open 7 days, 7:30am to 7pm. Not a 24-hour hospital; after hours use NEVS Terrey Hills or SASH.
entries.note: Emergency-care page lists a different phone (02 9519 4111) for Newport; location page number used.

entries.name: Sydney Animal Hospitals Avalon
entries.duty: Monday to Friday 8am to 7pm, Saturday 8:30am to 4pm. Closed Sundays and public holidays. Not a 24-hour hospital.

entries.name: Cardiff Veterinary Hospital
entries.duty: Mon-Tue 8am to 6pm, Wed-Fri 8am to 8pm, Sat-Sun 8am to 4pm. After hours call ahead and go to a 24-hour emergency centre.
entries.note: Page: not a 24-hour hospital; refers to AREC Broadmeadow and SASH Tuggerah.

entries.name: Brunker Road Veterinary Centre
entries.duty: After hours call the clinic first; emergencies are referred to a 24-hour emergency centre.
entries.note: Page names Newcastle Animal Emergency Centre (11 Perth Road / 4 Lang Road, (02) 4957 7106, i.e. AREC) and SASH Tuggerah as after-hours options. Clinic hours Mon-Fri 8am-6:30pm, Sat 8am-4pm, closed Sun and public holidays.

entries.name: Australian Animal Poisons Helpline
entries.duty: 24/7 animal poisons helpline for Australian pet owners. A consultation fee applies (from AUD 79).
entries.note: Page: '24/7 Helpline For Australian Pet Owners', 'from $79 AUD'. 1300 number is Australia-only (not dialable with +61 prefix); kept in domestic format.

notes: NSW run 1. Not covered: regional towns (Coffs Harbour, Port Macquarie, Byron, Tamworth, Orange, Wagga, Albury, Dubbo) - searches returned only aggregators, no clinic own pages opened. Not opened: ARH Baulkham Hills, ARH Greater Western Sydney (Minchinbury), SASH Rosebery/other referral pages, nevs.net.au, vsos.com.au (provenance refused), AVA and NSW VPB pages. Other Australian states not covered.
